blocks.text: A property owner may have land ready for development. An investor may be looking for the right opportunity. Architects, builders, and suppliers bring different expertise to the table. Bringing these interests together was at the heart of PhilBIG Builders & Projects Circle 2026, held on November 6 at Bigger Pictures in Greenfield District, Mandaluyong City. The gathering featured industry presentations, community recognition, professional networking, and fellowship, with light entertainment complementing the afternoon’s activities. Participants from real estate, architecture, construction, and related businesses had opportunities to meet fellow practitioners, exchange perspectives, and explore areas of mutual interest.
